player_input: I examine the bowed pump handle and the sheared pivot pin closely. What does this damage suggest?
emitted_response: The long iron handle of the bathhouse pump is noticeably bowed, bending outward from normal shape, and its pivot pin has been cleanly sheared through. Whether it was excessive wear or a sudden, violent pressure is unclear from the current evidence. Nearby, daily work presses on as Nessa folds towels quietly by a cedar bench, giving no hint of recent disturbance around the pump.
